material.name: Music Wire (High Carbon Steel)
material.description: High quality spring wire that is cold drawn with good surface finish. Highly magnetic. Generally good fatigue life due to high tensile strength.

material.name: Hard Drawn MB (High Carbon Steel)
material.description: General purpose spring wire for low to average stress applications. Cold drawn to desired properties. Highly magnetic.

material.name: Oil Tempered MB (High Carbon Steel)
material.description: General purpose spring wire for average stress applications. Highly magnetic. Often used for larger wire sizes when Music Wire is not available.
